I debated whether or not to make to make this a fork, or even make it public at all.  Eventfully, I decided to do both.  It's very, VERY similar to the original not just in the art, but also personality, and it felt disingenuous to not link it back to the OG.  While wrote up a lot of the code from scratch (Back when I was intending this to be a completely new bot), I decided to use a good deal of the original as well because, to be honest, it was fucking hawt.

I don't know if this changes too much to be a fork, if it changes too little to be worth it, or if this is an annoying blend of plagiarism and a modicum of originality, and I'll respond to any criticism or comments regarding that aspect should this all be a big, grey splotch of bad behavior on my part.
